blocks.text: 1952 mein American mahireen-e-hayatiyat Alfred Hershey aur Martha Chase ne bacteriophages, yaani bacteria par hamla karne wale viruses, ke zariye tajarbe kiye taa ke tasdeeq ho ke DNA hi genetic maadda hai.

Pas-e-manzar: bacteriophage ka andar DNA ya RNA ka hota aur bahar protein ka ghilaf. Lytic phage bacterium ki satah se jur kar kuch maadda cell mein inject karta hai; yeh maadda moroosi hai kyunke bacterium ke andar naye phages banwata hai, jo aakhir mein phat (lyse) kar unhein chhor deta hai. Sawal yeh tha ke phage kaun sa maadda, nucleic acid, protein ya dono, inject karta hai.

items: Unhon ne RNA ke bajaye DNA wala phage use kiya aur us ke hisson par mukhtalif radioactive isotopes ke nishan (tracers) lagaye.
Kuch phages sulphur-35 (35S) ke saath ugaye jo protein ghilafon ke amino acids mein gaya; doosre phosphorus-32 (32P) ke saath jo DNA ke phosphate groups mein gaya.
Setup 1: 35S nishan wale protein ke phages ne bacteria infect kiye. Setup 2: 32P nishan wale DNA ke phages ne bacteria infect kiye.
Kuch der baad infected cells aur medium centrifugation se alag kar ke radioactivity ke liye jaanche gaye.

blocks.text: Yaani infection ke dauran 32P nishan wala DNA bacterial cells mein gaya aur naye phages banwaye, jab ke 35S nishan wala protein ghilaf bahar raha. Hershey aur Chase ne nateeja nikala ke naye phages banane ki hidayat phage ka DNA deta hai, protein nahi.

blocks.alt: Do setups. Setup 1, radioactive sulphur (35S): radioactive protein ghilaf aur normal DNA wale phages bacteria par hamla karte hain; blender aur centrifugation ke baad radioactivity medium mein virus proteins mein hai aur bacterial cells mein koi radioactivity nahi. Setup 2, radioactive phosphorus (32P): radioactive DNA wale phages; blender aur centrifugation ke baad radioactivity bacterial cells ke andar virus DNA mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Do nishanon ke liye sulphur aur phosphorus kyun chune gaye?
blocks.explanation: Proteins mein sulphur (kuch amino acids mein) hota hai lekin DNA mein nahi; DNA mein phosphorus (phosphate groups mein) hota hai lekin protein mein bohat kam. Is liye har isotope sirf aik ko nishan lagata hai.

items: 35S phage protein ko nishan lagata; 32P phage DNA ko.
32P bacteria mein gaya; 35S medium mein raha.
Naye phages DNA banwata hai, protein nahi.
